title: Mining Progress Bar
description: Makes the mining progress look nicer.
body:
# ⛏️ Mining Progress Bar

Improves how block breaking looks by making the mining progress more clear and visually smooth from all angles.

## ✨ Features

* ⛏️ Cleaner mining progress visuals
* 🔄 Works from all directions
* 🎮 Vanilla-friendly look
* 🚀 No performance impact

> A simple upgrade to how breaking blocks feels and looks.
